facts.title: Chemical reaction
facts.text: NEL Aiku–Sae chemistry announced live; activation and effect were not specified.

facts.title: Aiku limited shop
facts.text: Serpent Rider emote, Snake True Aura cosmetic, Purple Aiku playercard, Aiku goal effect and Aiku Bundle.

facts.title: Ubers interaction
facts.text: Three different Ubers styles from Aiku, Don Lorenzo, Niko and NEL Barou on the opponent's side trigger a cutscene and 30-second buff. Three players give 5%; four give 10% shot-only boost. The source lists Aiku/Niko speed, Lorenzo lower cooldown and Barou shot.

history.title: Selfish Captain sound fix
history.text: Raised the sound level of Selfish Captain in new servers.

history.title: Aiku polish and quality of life
history.text: Serpent Wall returned to C; Selfish Captain was added; Venom Clearance and Crushing Bloom effects were corrected. NEL Aiku–Sae chemistry was announced as live.

history.title: NEL Aiku release
history.text: NEL Aiku arrived as an evolution style with a defensive base and awakening kit. Selfish Captain was still being revised at release.

history.title: Don Lorenzo revamp
history.text: New kit and goalkeeper-box awakening variant. A Ubers interaction rewards three or four distinct listed styles in the opponent half; new and revised jerseys were announced.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: Aiku rework
history.text: Earlier Aiku rework and limited items.

history.title: Aiku rework and AFK World
history.text: Aiku and flow reworked; AFK World refresh and balance changes announced.

history.title: Winter update part one
history.text: Aiku style and flow added with winter content.
